patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width dark backgrounds and full-width light backgrounds, creating clear visual breaks and content grouping.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, often accompanied by smaller, descriptive body text and occasional uppercase labels for emphasis.
A primary dark charcoal background is contrasted with a clean white, accented by a vibrant blue for links and a soft pink for primary call-to-action buttons.
The hero section features a background image with a subtle parallax effect, where the content scrolls over the image, while the main navigation bar becomes sticky after initial scroll.
The 'What sets us apart' section uses an asymmetrical two-column layout with a dark background, featuring a list of benefits on the left and a contrasting list of problems solved on the right.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented to stick to the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining accessibility to key links.
Hero background imagery is treated with a subtle parallax or fixed effect, where the foreground content scrolls over the image, creating depth without distracting movement.
Sections below the hero likely utilize GSAP ScrollTrigger to reveal content with staggered fade-up or slide-in animations as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's eye.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for impact, complemented by clear, readable body text and occasional uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to buttons and card-like elements, providing a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with airy hero and testimonial sections, transitioning to a more compact grid for feature lists and process steps.

standout: The site distinguishes itself with a sophisticated dark theme that uses a vibrant blue and soft pink as key accents, combined with a unique geometric overlay in the hero and a vertically oriented 'DREAM' section title that adds a modern, editorial touch.
